config.description: Path to the agent's Solana JSON keypair (solana-keygen new -o agent-keypair.json). Needed by the tools that spend; discovery and search tools run without it.

config.description: Hard cap for a single payment in USD (default 1)

config.description: Hard cap for total spend per UTC day in USD (default 10)

config.label: Owner mode (ADR-008): base58 address of the wallet that funds pay_checkout through its on-chain SpendAuthority
config.description: Owner mode (ADR-008): base58 address of the wallet that funds pay_checkout through its on-chain SpendAuthority. The agent signs but never holds the owner's funds; per-payment cap, daily ceiling and revoke are enforced by the Solana program. Unset means payments come from the agent wallet.
